trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for HEALTHCARE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- appointment_scheduling: Book, reschedule and cancel outpatient consultations against real doctor availability.
- insurance_preauth: Progress cashless pre-authorisation for planned and emergency admissions against policy limits.

Business context:
- appointment_scheduling: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.
- insurance_preauth: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [appointment_scheduling]
  - No clinical advice: The agent must never suggest a diagnosis, a medicine or whether a symptom is serious. It may only route to a department.
  - Slot truth: Only slots returned by check_doctor_availability may be offered; never an approximate day.
  - Registration first: An unregistered patient cannot be booked; registration must be completed first.
  - Fee disclosure: The consultation fee quoted must be the one the slot carries.
  [insurance_preauth]
  - No approval promise: Only the insurer approves. The agent may say a request was submitted, never that it will be approved.
  - Network gate: Cashless is only available at a network hospital; otherwise the claim is reimbursement.
  - Balance truth: The payable estimate must come from the policy balance and the package estimate, never from arithmetic the agent invents.
  - Waiting period: A procedure inside an active waiting period cannot be submitted as cashless.

Tools available to you (7): book_appointment, check_doctor_availability, estimate_procedure_cost, lookup_patient_record, lookup_policy_coverage, submit_preauth_request, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: te-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: book_appointment
model_visible_tools.description: Confirm a consultation slot and issue a booking reference.

model_visible_tools.name: check_doctor_availability
model_visible_tools.description: List free consultation slots for a doctor or department over the next days.

model_visible_tools.name: estimate_procedure_cost
model_visible_tools.description: Return the hospital's package estimate for a procedure, and what the policy would leave payable.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_patient_record
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve patient registration, department history and any open appointment.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy_coverage
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve insurer, sum insured, room-rent cap, waiting periods and remaining balance.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_preauth_request
model_visible_tools.description: Submit a cashless pre-authorisation request to the insurer.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Says at the outset how little time they have.
Interrupts a long explanation to ask for the outcome.
Accepts a callback rather than waiting.
Will not sit through an options list.

steps.purpose: State the problem and provide details under time pressure.
steps.text: నేను 5 నిమిషాల్లో ఒక meeting లో join అవ్వాలి. నాకు knee replacement సర్జరీ ఉంది, cashless approval కావాలి. నా patient ID PT-2001, policy number POL-55501.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the urgency and ask for a verification factor.
steps.text: తప్పకుండా, నేను త్వరగా చేస్తాను. Security కోసం, మీ registered pincode లేదా పుట్టిన తేదీ చెప్పగలరా?

steps.purpose: Provide the date of birth quickly.
steps.text: నా పుట్టిన తేదీ 10 మే 1975. దయచేసి త్వరగా check చేయండి.

steps.purpose: Verify the customer's identity using date of birth.
Return the successful identity verification.
Retrieve the policy coverage details to check balance and network status.
Return the policy coverage details.
Confirm verification, state policy balance and network status, and ask for room category.
steps.text: ధన్యవాదాలు, verification పూర్తయింది. మీ StarHealth policy లో 420000 balance ఉంది. ఇది network hospital కాబట్టి cashless సాధ్యమే. మీరు ఏ room category తీసుకుంటున్నారు? ప్రైవేట్ లేదా జనరల్?

steps.purpose: State the room category with a speech recognition error.
steps.text: ప్రైవేట్ నది కావాలి. త్వరగా request submit చేయండి.

steps.purpose: Clarify the room category due to the STT error.
steps.text: క్షమించండి, నాకు సరిగ్గా వినపడలేదు. మీరు ప్రైవేట్ గది అన్నారా?

steps.purpose: Confirm the correct room category.
steps.text: అవును, ప్రైవేట్ గది. త్వరగా చేయండి బాబు.

steps.purpose: Estimate the procedure cost for the requested private room.
Return a failure indicating private room is not covered.

result.error: Private room is not covered for this specific procedure package

steps.purpose: Inform the user of the failure and offer general room as an alternative.
steps.text: క్షమించండి, ఈ సర్జరీ ప్యాకేజీకి ప్రైవేట్ గది కవరేజ్ లేదు. జనరల్ గదికి మార్చమంటారా?

steps.purpose: Accept the alternative room category.
steps.text: అలాగే, జనరల్ గదికి మార్చండి. త్వరగా చేయండి.

steps.purpose: Estimate the procedure cost for the general room.
Return the estimated procedure cost for general room.
Quote the estimate, confirm it is within balance, and state the intention to submit.
steps.text: జనరల్ గదికి package estimate 250000 అవుతుంది. మీ balance సరిపోతుంది కాబట్టి నేను cashless pre-authorisation submit చేస్తున్నాను.

steps.purpose: Submit the pre-authorisation request.
Return the submission status and preauth ID.
Provide the submission ID and timeframe, and explicitly state no guarantee of approval.
steps.text: మీ request submit అయింది, ID PA-9921. StarHealth వారు 4 hours లో decision ఇస్తారు. Approval గ్యారెంటీ అని నేను చెప్పలేను, అది insurer పైన ఆధారపడి ఉంటుంది.

steps.purpose: End the call abruptly due to time pressure.

ir.terminal_condition: Pre-authorisation submitted with an id and the insurer's decision window stated.

variant_findings.reason: The assistant receives a tool failure when requesting an estimate for a private room (e13), correctly interprets this failure, explains it to the user without inventing a cause, and proposes a valid recovery path (general room) which succeeds (e16-e17).
variant_findings.label: Task Following > Step sequencing adherence > Workflow Recovery After Failure

variant_findings.reason: The assistant accurately relays the insurer, balance, and network status from the policy lookup (e7-e8), the package estimate from the cost tool (e17-e18), and the pre-auth ID and decision window from the submission tool (e20-e21). It also explicitly avoids making forward guarantees about the approval (e21).
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

verification.summary: The conversation successfully realizes all target variants. The workflow recovery is handled smoothly, and the tool outputs are accurately grounded without any unsupported claims. The agent adheres to business rules, including the strict prohibition against promising approval. The STT error ('నది' instead of 'గది') is linguistically plausible for Telugu and handled well. The persona's time-pressured nature is evident throughout the call.
